g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: USB-MIDI-controlled volume and pan for two balanced 1/4" line channels. Bus powered, no external supply.

g.desc: USB-MIDI-controlled volume and pan for two balanced 1/4" line channels. Bus powered, no external supply.

g.text: Sheets: 1 input, 2 matrix, 3 output, 4 control, 5 power. Nets between sheets are global labels; rails are power symbols.

g.desc: Sheets: 1 input, 2 matrix, 3 output, 4 control, 5 power. Nets between sheets are global labels; rails are power symbols.

g.text: Two grounds: GND_USB (XIAO, USB) and GND (audio). Only PS1 (power) and U8 (control) cross between them, plus C45 / R17.

g.desc: Two grounds: GND_USB (XIAO, USB) and GND (audio). Only PS1 (power) and U8 (control) cross between them, plus C45 / R17.

g.text: Signal flow: J1/J2 -> U1/U2 THAT1246 (-6 dB) -> C3-C6 -> U3/U4 PGA2310 2x2 matrix -> R2-R9 + U5 OPA2134 summers (x2) -> U6/U7 THAT1646 (+6 dB) -> J3/J4

g.desc: Signal flow: J1/J2 -> U1/U2 THAT1246 (-6 dB) -> C3-C6 -> U3/U4 PGA2310 2x2 matrix -> R2-R9 + U5 OPA2134 summers (x2) -> U6/U7 THAT1646 (+6 dB) -> J3/J4

g.text: Control: XIAO RP2040 USB MIDI -> U8 ISO7762F -> SPI (SCLK, SDI, /CS) + /MUTE -> U3 -> U4. Plug sense from J1/J2 ring-normal contacts, back through U8.

g.desc: Control: XIAO RP2040 USB MIDI -> U8 ISO7762F -> SPI (SCLK, SDI, /CS) + /MUTE -> U3 -> U4. Plug sense from J1/J2 ring-normal contacts, back through U8.

g.text: Power: XIAO 5V pin (USB 5 V) -> FB1 -> PS1 TBA 2-0522 -> +/-12 V (audio ground). +12 V -> U10 78L05 -> +5VA for PGA logic and U8 side 2.

g.desc: Power: XIAO 5V pin (USB 5 V) -> FB1 -> PS1 TBA 2-0522 -> +/-12 V (audio ground). +12 V -> U10 78L05 -> +5VA for PGA logic and U8 side 2.
